name: Badrutt's Palace Hotel
tagline: The Palace of St. Moritz, founded in 1896, with a new wing by Antonio Citterio.
description:
Badrutt's Palace Hotel is a hotel on Via Serlas in St. Moritz, in the Engadin valley of Switzerland, founded in 1896 by Caspar Badrutt. It runs a winter season from early December to the end of March and a summer season from June to early September, and its restaurants number up to eleven.

The Palace has views of Lake St. Moritz and a tower, and Via Serlas, the town's luxury shopping street, runs past its door. Cartier, Dior, Miu Miu and Yves Saint Laurent have shops on the ground floor. Guests have included Coco Chanel, Charlie Chaplin, Alfred Hitchcock and Marlene Dietrich, and the hotel was the first Swiss hotel named to The World's 50 Best Hotels list.

The guest rooms were designed by Champalimaud Design. The Serlas Wing, by Antonio Citterio Patricia Viel, adds 25 suites and rooms in oak, Dorato Valmalenco stone and Loro Piana fabrics, connected to the historic Chesa Veglia. Among the suites, the Hitchcock Suite is where Alfred Hitchcock found the idea for The Birds, and the Hans Badrutt Suite has a grand piano and one of the largest terraces in the hotel, and the Helen Badrutt Suite has a private balcony over the lake. The Tower Penthouse Apartment, with four bedrooms, takes the top three floors of the tower.

Le Grand Hall, known as the living room of St. Moritz, serves afternoon tea with a live pianist. La Coupole holds Matsuhisa, where Nobuyuki Matsuhisa serves Japanese and Peruvian cuisine under a glass dome in the former tennis hall. Le Relais is styled in the Belle Epoque, with dishes prepared tableside, Le Restaurant serves breakfast, and La Diala sits within the spa. Paradiso Mountain Club has more than 500 wines, and King's Social House, by Jason Atherton, is the oldest nightclub in Switzerland, reopened in 2018.

Palace Wellness was redesigned between 2008 and 2010 with an investment of 70 million Swiss francs. It has private spa suites, treatments, saunas, a salt steam room, a Technogym fitness centre and an indoor pool. The outdoor pool, redesigned in 2024, is the largest in St. Moritz and is heated with water from the lake. Ice skating, tobogganing, bobsleigh, ski instruction, a children's club called Pallazino and a teens' arcade are among the activities.

The Palace suits guests who want the centre of winter in St. Moritz, with restaurants, bars and shops under one roof.
